set.body:
Select exactly one CPU/allocation bottleneck demonstrated by PM3.2 profiling, reserve its affected implementation scope, and optimize it without changing scientific semantics or moving work out of the timed path. If the repair exceeds half a day, split it before editing. Historical ASC allocation amplification and the I-DT queue are leads, not predetermined conclusions.

Acceptance: meaningful before/after improvement against the frozen budget on the same workload/machine, raw repeated measurements and source-bound receipts; unchanged semantic outputs under named tolerances; affected conformance/regression and repository-required gates pass. Add the smallest reliable scaling/allocation regression check, with a scheduled timing comparison where CI timing noise precludes a stable per-commit threshold. Document memory/latency tradeoffs and remaining losses. Add bounded follow-on optimization slices for the remaining required matrix; a local win cannot close PM3.
set.title: PM3.3 Fix the first measured bottleneck and add its regression gate
